final: SELECT AVG(step1_avg_ratio), AVG(step1_match_count) FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price / ili.derived_total_cost) AS step1_avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS step1_match_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id)
